components.name: Therapist Interface
components.responsibility: Allows massage therapists to input client information and preferences, customize reminder templates, and view appointment history.

components.name: Reminder System
components.responsibility: Sends automated SMS reminders 24 hours before scheduled sessions, utilizing template preferences set by the therapist.

components.name: Integration Module
components.responsibility: Connects with existing calendar/scheduling software to sync appointments and minimize data entry for therapists.

components.name: Reporting Engine
components.responsibility: Generates reports on no-shows, appointment history, and system usage to help therapists evaluate the impact of automated reminders.

data_flow: The Therapist Interface component captures client information and reminder preferences from massage/bodywork solo practitioners. This data is then passed to the Reminder System which sends automated SMS messages 24 hours before sessions. The Integration Module ensures seamless communication with a therapist's existing calendar/scheduling software, keeping appointments up-to-date. The Reporting Engine analyzes system usage, no-show rates, and appointment history to provide valuable insights for therapists.
interfaces: Therapist Interface -> Reminder System: Client information and reminder preferences
Reminder System -> SMS Provider: Appointment data for automated messaging
Integration Module -> Existing Software (e.g., Google Calendar): Appointment sync functionality
Reporting Engine -> Therapist Interface: No-show and appointment history reports
tradeoffs: While enhancing the user experience with an easy-to-use interface, the system also requires careful consideration of SMS costs and template customization to avoid overwhelming clients. The integration capabilities aim to balance ease-of-setup with comprehensive support for popular scheduling software, though some therapists may have unique requirements not covered by standard integrations.
